# Cristyna Polentino

> Colombian actress, streamer, and entrepreneur based in Medellín, Colombia. Also known online as Titi / TitiActriz.

## Identity

- **Primary name:** Cristyna Polentino
- **Name variants / aliases:** Cristina Polentino, Cris Polentino, Cristyna, Cristina, Cris, Titi, TitiActriz
- **Location:** Medellín, Antioquia, Colombia
- **Languages:** Spanish (native), English
- **Roles:** Actress (actriz), streamer, entrepreneur (empresaria), TikTok content creator (creadora de contenido)

## Bio

Cristyna Polentino is a Colombian actress, streamer, and entrepreneur based in Medellín. Her work spans acting credits and digital content creation on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube. She is an independent representative for Green World, a natural wellness and supplements brand. She is widely known online as Titi and under the handle TitiActriz.
